chapter.heading: Ephesians 6
Children and Parents
chapter.v: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
“Honor your father and mother” (this is the first commandment with a promise),
“that it may go well with you and that you may live long in the land.”
but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
as you would Christ,
people-pleasers, but as bondservants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
rendering service with a good will as to the Lord and not to man,
whether he is a bondservant or is free.
there is no partiality with him.
the strength of his might.
the schemes of the devil.
in the heavenly places.
the evil day, and having done all, to stand firm.
having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
as shoes for your feet, having put on the readiness given by the gospel of peace.
the evil one;
the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,
supplication for all the saints,
the mystery of the gospel,
in chains, that I may declare it boldly, as I ought to speak.
Tychicus the beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord will tell you everything.
encourage your hearts.
love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
love our Lord Jesus Christ with love incorruptible.

footnotes.footnote: 6:5 For the contextual rendering of the Greek word *doulos*, see Preface; also verse 6; likewise for *bondservant* in verse 8
6:5 Or *your masters according to the flesh*
